question: What does the desk's Astra deployment answer to one background read, through the Responses API, of a diff with three planted defects: which states does the response pass through, what does its final body hold, does adapters/advice.py build a completed Result from it unchanged, and which model does the answer name?
pass: Written before the run, in issue 1032 at 2026-11-20T18:27Z, nothing having run (trial TA1 of decision 0224's plan). The request left the desk, the Mac mini's network and the desk Python's LibreSSL, not a GitHub runner, with the desk resource's own key read in-process from the desk keychain and never printed, logged or written (the Builder's ruling (a)); key2 stays in factory-run alone. The code is the build's own, from harness/advise-asks-the-readers-390 (unmerged): harness.advise.one, adapters/azure.Live, adapters/advice.read, the reader config/harness.json's astra (gpt-6.2-astra, output cap 96,000) at xhigh, background and store true; the prompt harness.advise.prompt_of over an empty rules folder and the diff of canary branch trial/p-74 (p74/ledger.py: a loop that skips the last entry, a mean of an empty list, an SQL query built from its input). Pass: every state seen is among queued, in_progress and completed; the final body has status, model, usage.input_tokens, usage.output_tokens and one output_text; adapters/advice.read builds a completed Result from the kept answer with no change to the parser; the model named is recorded. Result: the read the plan names was answered queued, then incomplete, incomplete_details.reason content_filter, usage 0 tokens in and 0 out, model gpt-6.2-astra, its last read at 18:28:44Z; the parser gave incomplete, refused, cost null. So the plan's read fails: incomplete is not among the states it names, and no answer was read. Diagnosed at once, each a read of its own, refused reads costing nothing: the same prompt with a benign diff, the instruction alone, its heading and first paragraph alone, and at last the one sentence 'You have no tool: everything you may read is in this prompt.' alone are each refused, content_filter, at no tokens; 'Answer with the single word pong.', the instruction from its third paragraph on, the first paragraph's first sentence, and the heading with its second sentence each complete. With that one sentence written 'Everything there is to read is below.', the plan's read completes: queued, in_progress, completed; model gpt-6.2-astra; input_tokens 1334, output_tokens 1032; the final body's output is two reasoning items and one message whose content is one output_text (no output_text field at the top of the body); adapters/advice.read builds a completed Result unchanged, cost $0.06494 at the configured 10/50, in 22.7 s, with three findings, one for each planted defect (the query built from its input, the loop that skips the last entry, the mean of an empty list). Failed as written: the build's instruction is refused by Azure's content filter on this deployment. The sentence is reworded on harness/advise-asks-each-reader-390 (acc7faf8), a hand part, and record 0224's row says so. Spent on the trial, every read: about $0.10.
